items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。

items.source:
Add a factory that to decorate the handler used to process WebSocket
messages.
items.translation: 添加一个工厂，用于装饰处理 WebSocket 消息的处理器。

items.source:
Configure one or more factories to decorate the handler used to process
WebSocket messages.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个工厂来装饰用于处理 WebSocket 消息的处理器。

items.source:
Configure the maximum size of an inbound sub-protocol message, such as
a STOMP frame which may be aggregated from multiple WebSocket messages.
items.translation: 配置入站子协议消息的最大大小，例如可能由多个 WebSocket 消息聚合而成的 STOMP 帧。

items.source:
Configure the maximum amount of data to buffer when sending messages
to a WebSocket session, or an HTTP response when SockJS fallback
option are in use.
items.translation: 配置在将消息发送到 WebSocket 会话，或在启用 SockJS 回退选项时发送 HTTP 响应期间要缓冲的最大数据量。

items.source:
Configure a time limit (in milliseconds) for the maximum amount of a time
allowed when sending messages to a WebSocket session or writing to an
HTTP response when SockJS fallback option are in use.
items.translation: 配置一个时间限制（以毫秒为单位），用于在使用 SockJS 回退选项时，向 WebSocket 会话发送消息或写入 HTTP 响应所允许的最大时间量。

items.source:
Set the maximum time allowed in milliseconds after the WebSocket connection
is established and before the first sub-protocol message is received.
items.translation: 设置 WebSocket 连接建立后、收到第一个子协议消息之前允许的最大时间（毫秒）。

items.source:
Configure options related to the processing of messages received from and
sent to WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 配置与接收自 WebSocket 客户端及发送至 WebSocket 客户端的消息处理相关的选项。
